text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm pulling together a compact 'Security & Deployment ops-sheet' (single-sided) for field + webinar handout. Need: 3 SLA bullets, short deploy-mode decision outline, one routing snippet for inbound leads, and two headline options. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

maya: Love it. Can we make the messaging customer-facing (not technical) but include a tiny tech callout for platform teams?

jordan: Agree. For SLAs: 99.9% uptime, P95 latency targets per model class, and incident response (1hr P1). Short and measurable.

sam: For deploy-mode outline: a 3-row decision table: Hosted (fast start), Dedicated (predictable throughput), Private (compliance + isolation). Keep it tiny — icons > text.

elaine: For inbound routing snippet — sales wants to tag leads by compliance need and scale. Proposal: 
```
# inbound routing pseudo-config
if lead.tags contains ["fedramp","pci","hipaa"] -> route: enterprise-security
elif expected_qps > 500 -> route: dedicated-sales
else -> route: self-serve-nurture
```
Keep as plain text in the sheet.

maya: Nice. Also add a 1-line webinar hook: "How to balance latency, cost and compliance when shipping LLM features" — under the CTA.

alex: Two headline options I drafted: 1) "Secure, predictable LLM inference for enterprise apps" 2) "Ship LLM features with SLA-grade performance and compliance" — feedback?

jordan: I prefer #1 for field; #2 is better for compliance audiences. Maybe present both as A/B suggestions.

sam: Can we include a micro-case: "Retail search -> moved to Dedicated, cut 95th percentile latency by 40% while lowering cost 12% via batching" — short, metrics-first.

elaine: Add a one-line QA note: "Private deployments supported with VPC and optional on-prem bundle; KMS integrations available."

maya: For visuals: a small 3-icon row (latency, cost, compliance) with one-line benefit under each. That will help sales in quick demos.

alex: Perfect. Also need one bite-sized field checklist for the rep: 
- Customer constraint? (SLA / data residency / qps)
- Recommended mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Suggested next step (POC / security review / pricing call)

sam: One more: include inbound tags the SDR should add: compliance:yes/no, expected_qps:<number>, priority:high/med/low

deploy-bot: reminder: marketing assets must pass legal review for compliance claims. Submit draft via /assets-review by EOD to avoid blocking webinar deck. :white_check_mark:

alex: Good call — I'll drop the draft into /assets-review when done. Who can proof the copy quickly?

maya: I can do the copy pass tonight. Jordan can validate SLAs + metrics.

jordan: I'll check SLA language and the micro-case metrics.

alex: Action items: maya copy pass, jordan SLA check, sam visuals + icons, elaine routing snippet formalized, alex final compile + submit to /assets-review by EOD tomorrow.

maya: I'll also draft the 30s webinar opener: "Most teams either overprovision for compliance or sacrifice latency to save cost. We'll show how to hit both — with orchestration, caching, and fallbacks"

sam: I'll build a lightweight Figma frame for the sheet (A4 single side) and link it here when ready.

elaine: Routing snippet formatted and added to the shared doc. Also added recommended tag values for SDRs.

alex: Thanks team — this is shaping up. If anyone hits blockers ping me in thread. We'll finalize next steps in the morning sync. :rocket:
